results.text:
Spent some real time with this Dell before writing a review, and it's held up well across the things that matter most to me.
Speed: The i7 1355U paired with 16GB of RAM is plenty for everything in my daily workflow — multiple browser windows open, video calls running, documents and spreadsheets going at the same time. Boot up is fast, the 512GB SSD makes file access instant, and I haven't run into the lag or stutter I had with my previous machine.
Display: The 2K resolution makes a real difference. Text is sharp, colors are accurate, and it's bright enough that I don't have to squint near a window. The touchscreen has been a nice bonus when I want to scroll quickly or interact with something on screen without reaching for the trackpad.
Battery: This was the one I was most skeptical about, but it's been a pleasant surprise. I can get through a normal work day without hunting for an outlet, and it charges back up quickly.
Build quality is solid, the keyboard is comfortable for long typing sessions, and the carbon black finish looks sharp without feeling flashy. For anyone looking for a reliable daily machine for work, this Dell is a strong choice
results.title: Reliable daily driver — speed, screen, and battery

results.text: I already had a Dell laptop that I was very happy with, but the motherboard got fried with a power surge when I took it to the beach on vacation.  After I cried for 2 days, I went looking for a new one and came across this laptop at Best Buy. Delivered to my door the next day, I shed one more tear for the one I had and loved and opened this new one.  DIdn't take long, fickle person that I am, I was in love with this one!  The black carbon finish feels really nice, not slippery like most.  It has twice the GB of my older one and is an i7 instead of an i5.  Easy to set up and get all my stuff back on, this baby loads like lightning and opening several tabs at once does nothing to slow it down. The only thing it does not have that my older one did have is a backlit keyboard, but I can live without that. I am VERY HAPPY with this product.  If I could choose any one I wanted, would I buy this one again?  Yes.
